answer: A tight ring of 60 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the zephyr calculation reruns each epoch, the sonnet weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the signal settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 43% independent neighbours on the funding graph. That is 30 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
